# Hive Axyl JS SDK

> TypeScript SDK that calls the Hive Axyl server APIs from browser (H5) games. npm package: `@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl`. It uses the same server APIs and the same rules as the Hive Axyl Unity SDK 1.0. It runs only in a browser page.

This file is a short guide for AI coding agents. The README in the package and the integration guide in the example repository are the full guide.

## Install and load

- npm: `npm install @com2usplatform/hiveaxyl`. Import `createAxyl` from `@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl` and each module from its own path, such as `@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl/auth`. ES modules and CommonJS both work. Type declarations are included.
- Without a build tool: load `dist/hiveaxyl-sdk.iife.js` with a `<script>` tag. It defines the global `HiveAxylSDK` with `createAxyl` and every module. Pin the exact version and add `integrity` and `crossorigin="anonymous"`.
- Modules: `auth`, `token`, `service`, `mailbox`, `coupon`, `analytics`, `payment`, `tcb`. Register only the ones you use. The others stay out of the bundle.

## Create a client

```ts
import { createAxyl } from '@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl'
import { auth } from '@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl/auth'
import { token } from '@com2usplatform/hiveaxyl/token'

const created = createAxyl({ appId, clientId, modules: { auth: auth(), token: token() } })
if (created.kind === 'failure') throw new Error(created.error.message)
const axyl = created.client
```

- `createAxyl` returns a `failure` when the page cannot run the SDK, for example without HTTPS. `localhost` also works.
- Supported browsers: Chrome and Edge 93, Firefox 92, Safari and iOS 15.4, or later. Every browser on iOS follows the iOS version. An older browser fails with a `TypeError` or cannot load the bundle. The oldest versions are not tested yet.
- Invalid options, an unregistered module and a module call after `dispose()` throw `AxylUsageError`. Fix the code when you see it. `axyl.isDisposed()` and `axyl.session` never throw. Check `isDisposed()` in code that can outlive the client.
- Keep the client in a module or closure variable, not on `window`. Load the SDK before third-party scripts.

## Results

Every call returns a promise of one of four kinds. Network, server and browser problems never throw.

- `success`: `r.data` holds the response.
- `outcome`: the server declined the call. `r.code` says why, for example `coupon_already_used`.
- `unknownOutcome`: the server sent a result code this SDK does not know.
- `failure`: a network, server or browser problem. `r.error.code` says why.

Give every `switch` on a result kind, `reason` or enum value a default branch. Later versions may add values. Choose the player's message by result code. `message` text is for developers. A failed query is not an empty list: keep showing the last data and offer a retry.

Log only a result's `kind`, `code`, `error.code`, `error.externalCode`, trace ID (`traceId`, or `error.traceId` for a `failure`) and, for a recipe result, `step`. Never log the whole result: `raw` can hold a payment receipt or a payment page URL.

## Failure codes

| Code                 | What your app does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Cancelled`          | The server may still have done the work. Check the state before you send the request again                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `Unknown`            | Show a general error. Report `externalCode` and `traceId`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `InvalidArgument`    | Fix the request in your code. The same request gets the same answer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `DeadlineExceeded`   | Offer a retry. A POST or PATCH may have reached the server, so check the state first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `NotFound`           | Do not send it again unchanged. `HTTP 404` means the server found no such API or resource                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `AlreadyExists`      | Do not send it again unchanged. Read the current state and continue from it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `PermissionDenied`   | Do not send it again unchanged. The player or the app is not allowed to do this. No `externalCode`: check `baseUrl`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `ResourceExhausted`  | Let the player try again after a while. Do not retry in a loop                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `FailedPrecondition` | `Env_InsecureContext`: serve the game over HTTPS. `localhost` also works. From `createAxyl` without `externalCode`: the browser lacks Web Crypto, so ask the player to update or switch the browser. A sign-in window is still open: wait for it. `Auth_RedirectStateMissing`: start the sign-in again in this tab. `Auth_SessionChanged` from the payment recipe's `openPayment()`: sign in as the player who paid and call `recoverPurchases()`. Offer a new payment only after that lookup found nothing: the player may already have paid in the old window. From `recoverPurchases()`: call it again for the player now signed in. `Auth_SessionChanged` from other calls: the call was not sent as the new player, so call again only if the player now signed in should make it |
| `Aborted`            | Sign in again. `Payment_InProgress` from the payment recipe: wait for the open payment to end. `Payment_CloseInProgress`: use the result of the first `closePurchase()`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `OutOfRange`         | Not returned in this release. Handle it in your `default` branch                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `Unimplemented`      | Do not retry. The server does not support this API                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `Internal`           | Show a general error and offer a retry later. Report `traceId`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `Unavailable`        | Check `externalCode` for the detail. Without it, a token refresh failed without a verdict, or the browser did not let a sign-in window, a payment window or the page move to its next page: let the player try again                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `DataLoss`           | Not returned in this release. Handle it in your `default` branch                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `Unauthenticated`    | Do not treat the player as signed out from this result alone. Wait for `session.on('change')`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

The README lists when each code happens and what the SDK already retried.

## Session and tokens

- Tokens stay in memory only. Do not store the access token in browser storage, logs or analytics.
- Keep the guest credential in `sessionStorage` only, under the game's own key. After a reload, the player's "Play as guest" press signs the same guest back in. Do not call `restoreGuest()` on page load. Never put the credential in `localStorage`, IndexedDB, cookies, logs or analytics. See `recipe-examples/guest-login.ts` in the example repository (https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-example-js). A guest who closes the tab loses the account, so let guest players link a sign-in provider before they build progress or buy items.
- Players sign in again after a page reload. Do not try to restore a session from storage. Read the starting state with `axyl.session.isSignedIn()`. Subscribing to `session.on('change')` does not send the current state. Show the sign-in screen on a sign-out from `change`. Enter the game from the sign-in result after the `isBlock` check.
- The later sign-in wins. The server keeps one session for each account and device. Tabs and clients of the site in one browser profile count as one device while browser storage keeps the device key. When the same account signs in on another tab or client, this session ends at its next token refresh with `change` reason `refreshRejected`. Sessions are not shared between tabs.
- The SDK does not react to the back/forward cache. A restored page keeps its session. The next call that uses the session refreshes an expired access token: before sending when the expiry is known, or after a 401.
- `axyl.session.getAccessToken()` returns the access token for your own game server only. The SDK never gives out the refresh token.
- Pass passwords as the player typed them. The SDK hashes them with SHA-256.

## Login recipe

Sign-in uses the login recipe `recipes/login.ts` from the example repository (https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-example-js). Copy it into the app. It needs the `auth` and `token` modules.

- Create one `createLogin` flow per client and share it. Chain a follow-up login or logout on the recipe call's result, not on the `change` event. A different recipe call returns `Aborted` while another one runs. The README's Usage section says when a listener can start a call.
- Call `provider()` and `linkProvider()` in the click handler before any `await`. Only synchronous checks may run before them. Browsers open a window only while they handle a click. The recipe opens the window at once.
- When the game page loads, call `completeProviderRedirect()` once, before any other recipe call and before your router changes the address. Do not also call `axyl.auth.completeRedirectSignIn()`: it removes the saved values, and the recipe then finds no sign-in to finish.
- Load third-party scripts, such as analytics, only after `completeProviderRedirect()` removed the callback parameters from the address.
- Check `isBlock` on a sign-in result before gameplay starts. A new guest's `isBlock` is always `false`. Call `auth.getBlockStatus()` if you need it.
- On `provider_owned_by_other` or `provider_type_already_exists` from `linkProvider()`, let the player decide. Never switch accounts or unlink a provider automatically.
- After a successful `linkProvider()`, drop the guest credential when its `guestPlayerId` equals the result's `playerId`. That credential no longer works. `provider_already_connected` and `provider_type_already_exists` also mean this player already has a link, so drop it then too. Those results carry no `playerId`, so read `axyl.session.playerId()` before the call.
- A sign-in that ends as `user_canceled` right after the window opened may have lost its link to the window. Offer the redirect sign-in as another button. The recipe does not do this for you: call `axyl.auth.startRedirectSignIn()`. When the game page loads again, `completeProviderRedirect()` finishes that sign-in too.
- Steam sign-in needs a Steamworks Publisher Web API Key in the Hive Axyl console, without an IP limit. A user Web API Key ends the sign-in with `provider_request_failed`. See the Steam Web API Key section of the integration guide.
- Apple sign-in uses Apple JS by default. Call the recipe's `preloadAppleJs()` when the sign-in screen opens, and allow `https://appleid.cdn-apple.com` in `script-src`. A click before Apple JS has loaded returns `Auth_AppleJsNotLoaded`. Apple rejects loopback addresses such as `localhost`, so test Apple sign-in on a deployed `https:` page. The integration guide covers the Services ID setup and the optional Hive Axyl relay (`appleRelayUri`). The recipe guide (`recipes/README.md` in the example repository) says what the recipe does for Apple.
- `businessOutcome` and `failure` carry `step`, where the call stopped. After `login.logout()`, `sessionCleared` says whether that call signed the player out, whatever `kind` is.
- `username()` creates the account when the username has none. Tell the player when `isNewAccount` is true. `custom()` needs a fresh one-time grant key from your game server for every call. When your game server can issue grant keys, pass a fresh one as `grantKey` to `guest()` and `username()` on every call. A console that requires keys refuses a new account without one, with `grant_required_missing`.
- `detectEnvironment()` reports an in-app browser or an iframe. The SDK shows no message. Tell the player to open the game in a regular browser. Google sign-in can fail inside an in-app browser, even with the redirect sign-in, so check `detectEnvironment()` first. In-app browser detection is best effort: an app that does not mark its User-Agent reports `null`. Inside an iframe, never move the page to a provider: providers such as Google refuse to show inside a frame. When the popup is blocked there, the login recipe returns `WebAuthPopupBlocked` instead of moving the page.
- A portal `<iframe>` with `sandbox` needs `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"`. Without `allow-scripts` the game does not run. Without `allow-same-origin` the sign-in answer cannot reach the game, so sign-in ends as `user_canceled` even after the player signs in. When a portal page on another origin sends `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, sign-in and payment end as `WebAuthPopupBlocked`, not `user_canceled` or `closed`, and a blank window stays open that the SDK cannot close. When `detectEnvironment().inIframe` is `true`, ask the player to open the game outside the portal, in its own tab. Show the game's address, because a `sandbox` without `allow-popups` also stops the game from opening that tab.
- A page with `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, as cross-origin isolation needs, cuts the link to sign-in and payment windows on other origins. Offer only the redirect sign-in there, and check payments with `recoverPurchases()`. Never use `'*'` as the `postMessage` target in a callback page.

## Payment recipe

- The SDK never confirms a payment. The game server must verify the receipt before it grants items. It verifies with the paying player's access token, not with server credentials.
- Call `openPayment()` from the payment recipe `recipes/payment.ts` in the click handler before any `await`. Only synchronous checks run before it.
- A `failure` can carry the `externalCode` `Payment_InProgress`: another `openPayment()` is still running. `Payment_CloseInProgress` means a `closePurchase()` of the same purchase is still running. Use the result of that call. A `failure` can also carry `Auth_SessionChanged`: the sign-in state changed during the call. The `Aborted` and `FailedPrecondition` rows of Failure codes above say what to do.
- Its `businessOutcome` and `failure` results carry `step`. `notFound` has none.
- If the sign-in state changed since `recoverPurchases()` or `openPayment()` returned a purchase, do not send that purchase to your game server and do not close it.
- Call `recoverPurchases()` after every sign-in and after each payment. A payment can finish after its window closed.
- After every `openPayment()` result that carries `purchase`, after `notFound`, a `payment_resource_not_found` without `purchase`, after a `failure` at the `restore` step, and after a `Cancelled` at the `storePurchase` step, call `recoverPurchases()` once more when the player next returns to the game.
- In Chromium and WebKit browsers, such as Chrome and Safari, a `signal` or `dispose()` that cancels a payment after the window moved to the payment page ends the call as `Cancelled` but leaves the window open. The player can still pay there, so call `recoverPurchases()` when the player returns.
- Pass a closing receipt from your game server as `closePurchase(purchase, { receipt })`. Build `accountUuid` with `accountUuid(namespace, playerId)`.

## Direct calls

Call `axyl.auth.openSignInPopup()`, `axyl.payment.openPaymentWindow()`, `axyl.auth.startRedirectSignIn()` and `axyl.auth.completeRedirectSignIn()` yourself only for a flow the recipes do not cover. Open their window on the first line of the click handler, before any `await`.

## Links

- [README](https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-js/blob/main/README.md): full guide, retry and wait times, page security, browser storage
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-example-js/blob/main/INTEGRATION.md): install, console setup, page requirements, game server work, first integration step by step, and a review checklist for code an AI agent wrote. Check your integration against that checklist
- [Example repository](https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-example-js): the login and payment recipes, their usage examples and the callback page to copy into your game
- [Hive Axyl Unity SDK](https://github.com/com2usplatform/hiveaxyl-sdk-unity): the SDK this one follows
